youtube.title: The Human Experiment Who Walked Away
youtube.description:
The most famous stomach in medical history belonged to a man who kept leaving. Alexis St. Martin walked away from Dr. Beaumont in 1825, was brought back with his wife and two children, signed a contract as a "covenant servant" in 1833, and then never went back, despite 18 years of letters and bigger offers.

The full story, from the accident to the last letter: "The Man With a Window Into His Stomach" (linked above).
